initial_in_progress_observation.statement: The unsupported curve on the tee carrier is turning out beautifully btw. Please make a note of it, and ensure we do the same elsewhere (e.g. enclosure back top) and don’t use supports on those 0.08 rounded surfaces.

finished_surface_observation.mechanism_observed_by_user: An edge lifts or pulls inward into the nozzle path; the nozzle drags it while depositing the next layer.
finished_surface_observation.recovery: The curve recovers as it approaches vertical, within the 0.08 mm band and before the change to 0.24 mm.
